・“What were the largest ADA transactions in the last 24 hours?”
・“How many wallets hold over 200,000 ADA?”
・“Plot a bar chart showing monthly smart contract deployments in the last year.”

ms.promise:
CAP will use features from cardano-node, db-sync, and APIs to extract data from the cardano network. CAP needs to extract data (output 1) from the Cardano network to structure it in a triplestore to support semantic search. In this sense, the data must be aligned (output 2) according to the ontology delivered on Milestone 1. The data extraction, transformation and loading into the knowledge base delivered on Milestone 1 will be performed by ETLs pipelines (output 3). We will create tests (output 4) to assert if the implemented mechanisms are performing according to the expected behaviour. That is, extracted data is correctly retrieved and injected in the Knowledge Base according to the ontology definition.
・Basic data extraction from the Cardano network
・Extraction components and ontology alignment mechanisms
・ETL pipelines for transforming and loading data
・Data extraction and ETL pipelines tests
ms.criteria:
・Data extraction mechanisms
・support the data described in CAP use cases, data types, and data model documented in Milestone 1 technical report 
・are successfully extracting data from the Cardano network according to available tests (output 4)
・Data extraction components have ontology alignment mechanisms according to the data types and data model documented in Milestone 1 technical report
・ETL pipelines are transforming and loading data into the Knowledge Base according to available tests (output 4)
・Data extraction and ETL pipelines tests cover the data types and data model documented in Mil
ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Team,
We are pleased to submit the deliverables for Milestone 2. This milestone focused on implementing and testing the data extraction, ontology alignment, and ETL mechanisms required to populate the semantic knowledge base with data from the Cardano network.

Milestone 2 Deliverables (Outputs):
1. Data Extraction Mechanisms – Components utilizing `cardano-db-sync` to extract the data.
2. Ontology Alignment Mechanisms – Components ensuring that extracted data is structured in accordance with the ontology delivered in Milestone 1.
3. ETL Pipelines – Pipelines for orchestrating data extraction, transforming and loading extracted data into the knowledge base.
4. Tests – tests validating that data is correctly extracted, transformed, and aligned with the ontology.
5. Video Walkthrough (bonus) – Available at: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abX0FFlzOBuuKQ69AFEj5zZFaWLZfotB/ 

Deliverables 1-4 are available in our project’s GitHub repository: http://github.com/mobr-ai/cap 

We look forward to your review and feedback.

﻿Kind regards,
MOBR team
